locator: p. 222, 'Influence of the nonlinear structural terms'; Figures 10-11
floating_tubes: 60 cm diameter floating tubes are distributed along the riser to stabilize it (distribution, length coverage and tube mass not given)

boundary_conditions.head: vertical movement and rotation free; horizontal movement prescribed

head_displacement.text: sinusoidal variation with a period of 9 s and an amplitude of 7.70 m

head_tension.text: tension at the head has also a sinusoidal variation of same period

wave.text: An Airy wave (in finite depth) with a period of 9 s and an amplitude (through-to-crest) of 6 m

current_profile_reading: Figure 10 draws straight segments between the labelled points; the bottom value (0 m/s at 1200 m) is read from the figure (the profile meets the vertical axis at the sea bottom), not a printed label.
integration_step_text: an integration step of 0,1 s, which has been found to be optimum for the 'nonlinear structure' case
analyses: 'linear structure' (initial tangent stiffness; rotation terms neglected)
